title: Orbit onboarding panels: traffic-profile presets, SLA contrast frames, and autoscale microcopy
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact visual kit and screenshot set for the Dedicated onboarding quickstart that communicates three things at a glance: traffic-profile presets (burst, steady, seasonal), an SLA-contrast frame that clarifies latency/uptime tradeoffs across tiers, and a concise autoscale microcopy pattern. Goal is a set of assets for product docs, in-console onboarding, and release notes: 3 hero screenshots, 3 small explanatory cards, 2 microflow overlays, and a small illustration asset for marketing. Focus on terse language that helps engineers choose an initial reserve size and autoscale policy quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct hero screenshots exported at 1440x720: compact-panel, timeline-slice, and overlay-explain
Set of 3 traffic-profile preset cards (Burst, Steady, Seasonal) with token-cost + latency callouts
SLA contrast frame comparing Reserved, Dedicated-Standard, and Dedicated-Premium with clear uptime and p50/p95 latency bands
Microcopy for autoscale behaviour (3 variations) reviewed and approved by PM and Eng
Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in PRD; ready for localization handoff
Design handoff includes CSS tokens and spacing spec for Console engineering
comments: 2025-08-13 - MC: Kickoff meeting with PM and Eng. Agreed scope: hero screenshots + 3 small cards + microcopy variants.
2025-08-18 - LA: Early layouts uploaded to Figma. PM prefers layup that surfaces predicted monthly token cost for each preset.
2025-08-22 - SR (PM): Please add a line about fallback behaviour when Reserved capacity is exhausted.
2025-08-27 - LA: Updated timeline slice includes fallback badge and brief tooltip copy. Pushed new exports to Drive.
2025-08-30 - ENG-5221 update: Confirmed slot sizing metrics for Reserved; provided p50/p95 numbers for standard models.
2025-09-02 - MC: Design review with UX writing. Resolved on microcopy variant B for clarity and brevity. Preparing final exports.
review_notes: PM: Ensure the SLA contrast frame doesn't overload with numbers — prefer bands and a single callout metric.
Eng: Add an annotation to hero screenshots showing 'estimated inference slots' and the measurement interval used.
Legal: avoided specific SLA legalese; this is for onboarding only and must include link to formal SLA in tooltip.
UX Writing: Replace 'capacity' with 'reserved throughput' in UI to reduce ambiguity for non-infra engineers.
decisions: Use three traffic-profile presets (Burst / Steady / Seasonal) with a one-line intent label and a cost-latency badge
SLA contrast uses visual bands (p50/p95) and a single uptime percentage per tier rather than dense tables
Microcopy variant B chosen: short imperative + one-sentence tradeoff (e.g., 'Reserve for consistent low latency. Use burst for short spikes.')
Export resolutions standardized at 2x for retina and 1x for docs; include SVGs for cards
